decisions.reason: Training Effectiveness and initial Power are accurately represented with canonical terminology.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded support.training_effectiveness.effect155 requires Training Effectiveness and common.stat.power requires Power.

decisions.reason: This is a pair of Support Effect bonus labels; using the established Skill Pt Bonus form is clearer and consistent with adjacent category-155 effects while preserving the required Skill Pt resource term.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded support.power_bonus.effect155 requires Power Bonus; common.skill_points requires Skill Pt, and the same category uses Skill Pt Bonus for the bonus effect.

decisions.proposed_text: Khi Friendship Gauge đạt 80 trở lên,\nSpeed Bonus & Skill Pt Bonus
decisions.reason: The threshold refers to the Support Card Friendship Gauge, not generic liên kết; both following effects are player-facing bonus labels.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.friendship_gauge.support_effects requires Friendship Gauge, support.speed_bonus.effect155 requires Speed Bonus, and common.skill_points requires Skill Pt.

decisions.reason: Wit Bonus is canonical; only the unnecessary mid-label capitalization of Cuộc đua needs normalization.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded support.wit_bonus.effect155 requires Wit Bonus; race.generic locks Cuộc đua.

decisions.reason: Speed Bonus and the initial Wit increase are accurately represented with canonical terminology.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded support.speed_bonus.effect155 requires Speed Bonus and common.stat.wit requires Wit.
